claims.claim_text: de Moura 的定調是「This is an implementation bug, not a hole in Lean's meta-theory.」
claims.evidence: This is an implementation bug, not a hole in Lean's meta-theory.
claims.note: Verbatim match in the postmortem, authored by Leonardo de Moura on his own blog.

claims.claim_text: 7 月 25 日 Ramana Kumar 發表 Collatz「反證」，三天後 Kiran Gopinathan 縮成 False 最小證明，開出 issue #14576。
claims.evidence: On July 25, Ramana Kumar published a repository containing a `sorry`-free 'disproof' of the Collatz conjecture, produced with AI assistance. On July 28, Kiran Gopinathan reduced it to a small proof of False and opened issue #14576.
claims.note: July 25 to July 28 is exactly the 三天後 the lede states; issue number matches.

claims.claim_text: 根因在 kernel 消去 nested occurrence 時 phantom 參數從輔助型別上消失，躲過型別檢查。
claims.evidence: When the kernel eliminates a nested occurrence under an inductive type `T` with parameters `Ds`, and these parameters are phantom (not mentioned in constructor fields), they disappear from the generated auxiliary type and thus escape type checking.
claims.note: The Chinese rendering tracks the source's causal chain step for step.

claims.claim_text: 修補在回報後一小時內以 PR #14577 推出，由 Joachim Breitner 審過並合併。
claims.evidence: We pushed a fix one hour after the report (#14577). Joachim Breitner reviewed it and suggested improvements, and it was merged.
claims.note: Source says 'one hour after the report', lede says 一小時內; negligible at this precision. PR number and reviewer exact.

claims.claim_text: 理由用他們自己的話說是「Encrypting large payloads with asymmetric keys alone is very expensive」
claims.evidence: Encrypting large payloads with asymmetric keys alone is very expensive.
claims.note: Verbatim, and it is the source's own stated rationale for ECIES-on-DEK only.

claims.claim_text: 實測在每秒 5,000 筆、數十 KB 訊息的尖峰下，每個 instance 的 CPU 增幅低於 1%。
claims.evidence: Across all measurements, CPU increase per instance was below 1%. ... highest RPS (up to 5,000 requests per second) and message sizes of tens of kilobytes
claims.note: Scrutinised for conflation with the title's '1M messages per second': the lede does NOT use that figure, it cites the benchmark condition. No conflation.

claims.claim_text: AES-GCM 的對稱 DEK 加內容，secp521r1 曲線的 ECIES 只加 DEK。
claims.evidence: We use AES-GCM to encrypt payloads. For DEK encryption, we use the elliptic curve integrated encryption scheme (ECIES) with the secp521r1 curve.
claims.note: Algorithm names and curve match exactly; envelope split as described.

claims.claim_text: 共用 KEK 免 header 膨脹；record-level 加密犧牲壓縮效率換 Kafka 標準擴充點相容。
claims.evidence: a model where multiple consumers share a single KEK from the start ... allow[s] using Kafka's standard extension points such as interceptors ... compression efficiency drops
claims.note: Both tradeoffs are the source's own stated reasoning.

claims.claim_text: 「Existing verification methods, like one-time passwords (OTPs) or email verification links (magic links), require the user to navigate away from your site.」
claims.evidence: Existing verification methods, like one-time passwords (OTPs) or email verification links (magic links), require the user to navigate away from your site.
claims.note: Verbatim including punctuation and parenthetical expansions.

claims.claim_text: 機制走 DNS，token 填進隱藏的 email-verification-token 欄位；驗證端檢查五件事。
claims.evidence: a `_email-verification` DNS TXT record on the email domain that delegates to an issuer ... `autocomplete="email-verification-token"` ... 1. Parse the token 2. Validate expected values 3. Validate key binding 4. Validate DNS record 5. Discover the issuer and verify the EVT signature
claims.note: Count and ordering of the five verifier-side checks match; origin trial confirmed.

claims.claim_text: release note 點名的適用情境是 I/O-bound workload，「such as those involving LLM calls」。
claims.evidence: can be very useful for I/O-bound workloads, such as those involving LLM calls
claims.note: Verbatim match of the quoted fragment.

claims.claim_text: fiber worker 在單一 fiber reactor thread 上跑 job，設定 fibers: 100；前提為 Async 相依與 isolation_level = :fiber。
claims.evidence: use fibers on a single fiber reactor thread ... workers: - queues: "api*" fibers: 100 polling_interval: 0.05 ... It uses Async under the hood, so you need to have that as a dependency for it to work. ... config.active_support.isolation_level = :fiber
claims.note: Version tag v1.6.0 is the fetched release page itself. Config key, value, both prerequisites match.

claims.claim_text: 4x4x4 TPU 7x（Ironwood，256x256 systolic array）訓練 110B MoE：forward pass 1.85 PFLOPS compute-bound，routing/attention 30-60% SOL，step time 少 21.2%。
claims.evidence: The forward-pass and dense-core operations were primarily compute-bound, reaching 1.85 PFLOPS. Conversely, the routing and attention primitives in the MoE architecture remained memory-bound, operating at 30-60% of the SOL due to HBM saturation ... Microbenchmark results directly guided interventions that reduced the training step time by 21.2%.
claims.note: Every figure checks out. The lede names only the forward pass where the source says forward-pass AND dense-core: a narrowing, not an inflation.

claims.claim_text: 五個量測面向與三種 Roofline 分類。
claims.evidence: all-gather, all-reduce, reduce-scatter, and all-to-all ... GEMM operations measured in TFLOPs and Model FLOPs Utilization (MFU) ... memory bandwidth measured in GB/s ... Host-to-Device (H2D) and Device-to-Host (D2H) ... Ragged-Paged Attention (RPAv3) ... Compute-bound: 'hitting the MXU plateau' ... Network-bound: 'Stalls in ICI or DCN'
claims.note: Five categories and the three-way classification match the source's own structure.

claims.claim_text: 五個 frontier agent 裡最好的 Medium 25.3%、Hard 10.0%。
claims.evidence: Across five frontier agents, the best RCA Accuracy is 25.3% on Medium-difficulty tasks (the realistic-input setting) and 10.0% on Hard
claims.note: Both percentages and agent count verbatim from the abstract.

claims.claim_text: 六天遙測、1,079 個 RCA 任務、SRE 簽核、Cohen's kappa_w=0.90。
claims.evidence: exposing six days of metrics, logs, and traces through real telemetry interfaces (Prometheus, Jaeger, and OpenSearch via Grafana) and full source-code access--with 1,079 RCA tasks ... signed off by expert SREs, and our LLM-as-judge is independently re-scored by humans (Cohen's kappa_w=0.90).
claims.note: Task count, tool stack and kappa all match verbatim.

claims.claim_text: 最弱的那個在 40% 的事件報告裡編出站不住腳的根因。
claims.evidence: The weakest model hallucinates an implausible root cause in 40% of incident reports
claims.note: Referent matches; 40% stated flatly, not hedged.

claims.claim_text: 作者強調這個差距是下限。
claims.evidence: Crucially, these are performances on a curated 50 GB / six-day testbed with tasks investigated in isolation ... the gap we report is a lower bound on the engineering investment required
claims.note: 'the gap we report is a lower bound' is the authors' own first-person framing.

claims.claim_text: 「interfaces still can't declare type-parameterized methods, and a generic method can't be used to satisfy an interface」
claims.evidence: interfaces still can't declare type-parameterized methods, and a generic method can't be used to satisfy an interface
claims.note: Verbatim match; surrounding framing also supported.

claims.claim_text: crypto/mldsa、RFC 9562 的 uuid、encoding/json/v2 畢業、實驗性 simd。
claims.evidence: crypto/mldsa - Post-quantum ML-DSA digital signatures per FIPS 204 ... uuid package - New standard library package implementing RFC 9562 ... encoding/json/v2 - Graduates from experimental status ... simd package - Experimental portable SIMD implementation
claims.note: All four package claims including RFC number and status labels present.

claims.claim_text: Servo 六月合進 558 個 commit（四月 534、五月 391）。
claims.evidence: Servo 0.4.0 contains all of the changes we landed in June, which came out to yet another record 558 commits (April: 534, May: 391).
claims.note: All three figures verbatim in the same parenthetical form.

claims.claim_text: 可變字型處理的改善讓 Zulip 與 Speedtest 這類網站好讀很多，lichess.org 則是真實網站相容性本身明顯改善。
claims.evidence: Real world compat has significantly improved on lichess.org, and many websites have become a lot more readable thanks to our improved handling of variable fonts (@simonwuelker, #45768), including Zulip (servo.zulipchat.com) and Speedtest (speedtest.net).
claims.note: Round 1 found citation drift: the lede had folded Lichess into the variable-font list, but the source credits variable fonts only for Zulip and Speedtest and attributes lichess.org to general real-world-compat improvement. Corrected in the fix loop to split the two causes; the revised sentence now matches the source's attribution.

claims.claim_text: Google Maps 與 OpenStreetMap 已經渲染得不錯，只剩一些互動上的小問題。
claims.evidence: Other websites, like Google Maps (maps.google.com) and OpenStreetMap (www.openstreetmap.org), render well but have some issues with interactivity.
claims.note: Close paraphrase at the source's own strength, no upgrade.

claims.claim_text: 「the OpenAPI 3.0 specification of the symmetric API to be used to coordinate managed L3 connectivity」
claims.evidence: Describes the OpenAPI 3.0 specification of the symmetric API to be used to coordinate managed L3 connectivity.
claims.note: Clean substring quote, not an alteration. Repo name aws/Interconnect confirmed.

claims.claim_text: 第一個對象是 Oracle Cloud，五月公開預覽、現在 GA；Google Cloud 跟進，Azure 排在 2026 年稍晚。
claims.evidence: In May, OCI launched support for AWS Interconnect in public preview ... GA launch ... allowing AWS customers to connect workloads on OCI and Google Cloud ... Microsoft Azure will launch later in 2026
claims.note: Supported and if anything understated. Independence noted: this source is a blog echoing AWS's own announcement, not independent reporting; the lede claims no multi-source confirmation.

claims.claim_text: 「There's no guarantee the chain of thought has to be meaningful in any sense」
claims.evidence: There's no guarantee the chain of thought has to be meaningful in any sense.
claims.note: Verbatim and correctly attributed to William Merrill; the article lists him with NYU.

claims.claim_text: Northeastern 與 UC Berkeley 研究：30% 到 60% 的思考步驟因果影響極小，原文用詞 minimal causal impact。
claims.evidence: A 2025 paper from Northeastern University and the University of California, Berkeley on frontier open-source LRMs showed that between 30% and 60% of their "thinking steps" had "minimal causal impact" on the answers the models produced to benchmark math questions.
claims.note: Institutions, range, scoping and the exact term all check out. The lede omits the benchmark-math scoping: a mild generalisation that does not overstate the finding's strength.

claims.claim_text: 文章訪到 Melanie Mitchell、Subbarao Kambhampati 與 Sébastien Bubeck。
claims.evidence: Melanie Mitchell (Santa Fe Institute) ... Subbarao Kambhampati (Arizona State University) ... Sébastien Bubeck (OpenAI)
claims.note: All three appear as sources in the article.

claims.claim_text: 可見的推理軌跡更像餵回給模型的脈絡提示。
claims.evidence: LRMs generate "chains of thought" and feed them back into themselves ... Rather than representing actual reasoning computation, these traces function as context that loads the model's window
claims.note: Supported. The lede pre-hedges with 論點大致是, weaker than the article's framing: deflation, no action.
